dunkin-brunswick.review_snippet: Delicious hot mocha latte this morning, and tasty fresh donuts!!! Thanks for all your hard work its appreciated!

the-farmhouse-exchange-thurmont.review_snippet: Carryout only sandwiches were made to order and excellent. Lots of distracting baked goods and refrigerated foods to purse while you wait. Just be prepared that seating is only available outside with no shade.

bollingers-restaurant-and-uncle-dirtys-b.review_snippet: Super cute place and good food. The baked potato with broccoli and cheese was baked to perfection.

thurmont-kountry-kitchen-thurmont.editorial_summary: American eatery serving classic country meals in a relaxed, old-school atmosphere.
thurmont-kountry-kitchen-thurmont.review_snippet: So glad I picked this for breakfast today. Pumpkin pancakes were absolutely delicious and we all enjoyed our meals. Definitely worth the stop.

10tavern-thurmont.review_snippet: Great place. Huge food portions and great taste. Staff is friendly and welcoming! Had the chicken ceaser wrap, it was huge, Nashville chicken sandwich and bang bang shrimp. Wonderful lunch.

sheetz-thurmont.editorial_summary: Chain offering fuel & familiar convenience goods, including packaged snacks, drinks & takeaway fare.
sheetz-thurmont.review_snippet: An amazing worker, mary doing the mto orders at 1am, went above and beyond to make my special request happen! Now I can be happy eating my food, thanks to her! ( bring back your nacho cheese on hotdogs asap)

mountain-gate-family-restaurant-thurmont.editorial_summary: Large family dining spot offering a buffet plus a full menu of down-home American country cooking.
mountain-gate-family-restaurant-thurmont.review_snippet: Wonderful atmosphere! Celebrated my mom's 78th bday here! The staff is very delightful. Food is delicious and cooked upon ordering. They have a buffet bar; salad bar; dessert bar

fratellis-ny-pizza-thurmont.review_snippet: Had a great experience here. Greg was the greeter...10 plus rating. Food was top notch. BUTTER WAS SOFT...NOT A FROZEN LUMP. GREAT SERVICE, GREAT PRICE.

mcdonalds-thurmont.editorial_summary: Classic, long-running fast-food chain known for its burgers & fries.

crybaby-cafe-middletown.review_snippet: Absolutely charming spot perfect for an afternoon out with your little ones!

debs-artisan-bakehouse-middletown.review_snippet: Insane pastries!!! Highly recommend stopping! We were passing through and are soooo glad we came in. We got the fig/brie/almond pastry, the peach galette, and the blueberry maple biscuit. All heavenly perfection!

abbraccio-gelato-middletown.review_snippet: Delicious ice-cream! Check out the wonderful flavors! Yesterday they had 'Elvis' flavor!

hebrews-cafe-myersville.review_snippet: A cozy coffee shop with a wide selection of coffee and drink choices. Friendly staff and plenty of seating!

whistle-stop-coffee-walkersville.review_snippet: Finally stopped by Whistle Stop Coffee! I got the Blueberry Hill Latte. It was so yummy! Felicia was so friendly and helpful - letting me know which lattes would be lactose free. I’ll definitely be coming back!

el-rancho-restaurant-walkersville.review_snippet: Delicious breakfast food. Breakfast burrito and Philly cheesesteak omelet were amazing! Fast and friendly service. Coffee was slightly bitter, but that did not take away from the overall experience.

china-wok-walkersville.review_snippet: Absolutely delicious fresh egg rolls more than 1 piece of shrimp too. Beef n broccoli was spectacular.

italia-new-york-pizza-walkersville.review_snippet: My family and I ordered a large pepperoni pizza to-go. The employees were friendly and welcoming. The size of the pizza was bigger than what I was expecting! The pizza was delicious as well. First time customers and I highly recommend 👌💯

azteca-bar-and-grill-walkersville.review_snippet: Chips were warm and crunchy, salsa was fresh and I'm trying my first Shrimp Taco. Oh yea......that Dos Equis was ICE COLD. Not bad for a 10 lunch today.

mason-dixon-mixin-emmitsburg.review_snippet: Our first time here and our drinks were really good. We also tried the protein donuts. The service was great.

mcgowan-center-emmitsburg.review_snippet: clean, great personnel, enjoyed good coffee

saxbys-at-mount-st-marys-university-emmi.review_snippet: Had a great “Green Goals” smoothie here! will be coming back :)

5-west-cafe-new-market.review_snippet: I love this cafe. I go here 1-2 times a week. The staff is super nice. The food is amazing, and they have different little areas where you can drink your caffinated beverage of choice while you read or just enjoy the time in the quiet room!

stage-line-coffee-roasters-new-market.review_snippet: probably some of the best coffee i ever tasted, brought some back with me to tennessee recommended 💯

prospect-pantry-new-market.review_snippet: Nice and cozy atmosphere with excellent food. Got the chicken and waffles and it was delicious. Also got an açaí bowl and the salted caramel coffee. My teenage daughter loved everything and that’s quite the accomplishment!

mt-airy-mocha-new-market.review_snippet: Love it.... Been missing it lately I have not seen it?

vintage-restaurant-new-market.editorial_summary: Rustic-chic spot in a classic redbrick building for modern American comfort food & craft cocktails.

nana-b-sweets-new-market.review_snippet: My 4 year old daughter and I tried this bakery and the staff member was very friendly and welcoming. There is not much seating, we were lucky to get the bench outside just as another family left. Everything was delicious 😋

starbucks-mount-airy.editorial_summary: Welcoming coffeehouse with handcrafted coffee, espresso & tea, plus breakfast, lunch & pastries.
starbucks-mount-airy.review_snippet: pretty great Starbucks. very cozy with a lot of seating and I really enjoyed studying here for a week day to night while I was traveling. great staff overall. it has a drive through, which I didn't use.

concettas-main-street-bistro-mount-airy.editorial_summary: Bright space offering American breakfast eats & lunch options such as subs, plus outside seating.
concettas-main-street-bistro-mount-airy.review_snippet: I had a late notice catering order for a funeral lunch. Jeff, Sandy and the team pulled it all together and it was perfect! The food was delicious and looked beautiful, this is my go to place for catering!

ggs-pastry-shop-mount-airy.review_snippet: Absolutely delicious. Flakey pastries and very balanced lemon roulade. We loved the light cream's contrast with the lemon curd. The cake part was similar to a pavlova (I think?), very unique and worked quite well.

mount-airy-inn-mount-airy.editorial_summary: Contemporary eatery supplying an upscale pub menu that includes brick-oven pizza & microbrews.

the-upper-deck-sports-bar-and-grill-moun.review_snippet: Great service. I drive an hour for these wings because nobody does them like the Upper Deck and no one else has this size.

tropical-smoothie-cafe-mount-airy.editorial_summary: Health-conscious cafe chain featuring a menu of custom smoothies, sandwiches & wraps.

olde-town-restaurant-mount-airy.editorial_summary: Cozy storefront cafe serving breakfast, burgers & a casual American menu with lots of crab dishes.
olde-town-restaurant-mount-airy.review_snippet: First time visiting, and I saw that they had received recognition for the best grilled cheese. So, I just had to try their adult grilled cheese. Let me just say, it didn't disappoint! Great food and service.

memories-charcoal-house-mount-airy.editorial_summary: Lively outpost for traditional American fare, including steaks, plus a sports bar & outdoor seating.

mount-airy-commons-mount-airy.review_snippet: This is my favorite gift shop! I love the variety they have from the all their different vendors. Definitely check out their events, too. I did the pet flower press one and it was so fun ☺️

black-mountain-roasters-boonsboro-myersv.review_snippet: I have been buying my coffee from Black Mountain Roasters for a few years. I have tried many of their different varieties and have enjoyed them all. They are a wonderful couple who produces a delicious cup of coffee.

doubs-meadow-park-myersville.review_snippet: Great little park with plenty to do. Nice playground for all ages, a nearly half-mile paved walking trail loop, creek access, plenty of ball fields, a basketball court, and a large pavilion. Always clean and well-maintained.

eklectic-coffee-bar-catering-only-myersv.review_snippet: I attended an event today and was blown away by the coffee! The service was outstanding. What a great concept. 5 stars all the way!

the-olde-towne-restaurant-woodsboro.review_snippet: This is the kind of restaurant that we missed. Old style cooking with good ambiance, and friendly server. The food was delicious. We will come back again.

trouts-market-woodsboro.review_snippet: I've been shopping here for 27 years. We're really lucky to have a grocery store nearby. Good people own and run it, too.

woodsboro-american-legion-woodsboro.review_snippet: The only game in town for a Legion! I've been a member for 19 years now. They support the local Boy & Cub Scouts. They have a kitchen, draft beer, mixed drinks. They do celebrations and wedding receptions.

the-greenhouse-cafe-thurmont.review_snippet: Cutest cafe, the drinks and food were so good. All the ingredients were fresh and just full of flavors. One of my new favorite places in the area. Will definitely come back.

burkittsville-historic-district-burkitts.review_snippet: The Shafer farmhouse was the headquarters of Gen. Franklin during the battle of South Mountain. PJ Gilligan is the oldest continuously operating general store in Maryland.

lima-soul-restaurant-frederick.review_snippet: Absolutely fantastic food and service! The ceviche trio was oso good!!

currys-kitchen-brunswick.review_snippet: We got steak and cheese sandwiches that were both great, the moz sticks were super crunchy too. Good portion sizes and everyone working there was very nice, excited to come back to try more.

pennys-diner-brunswick.review_snippet: Amazing little hole in the wall type place. Would've missed it if it weren't for the GPS earlier, the food is amazing and the automosphere is so lovely I feel like im back in the 80's

kings-pizza-brunswick.review_snippet: Fabulous Food!!! And Wonderful Staff!! Always greeted with smiles and friendliness. What a delish dinner!

wing-n-pizza-shack-brunswick.review_snippet: I couldn’t believe how great the deals are, I wish I would’ve found out about these sooner! The food was amazing and was delivered quickly. Highly recommend!

roy-rogers-brunswick.editorial_summary: Burgers & other fast-food options at a regional chain named after a legendary American cowboy actor.
roy-rogers-brunswick.review_snippet: Very friendly service. Our food was fresh and delicious. Very tasty onion rings. The order kiosk made searching through the menu very easy. I would come back for sure.

the-depot-frozen-custard-brunswick.review_snippet: The customer service is top tier and the custard was to die for. I will definitely be back.

snowfox-sushi-brunswick.review_snippet: It’s in Weis but the sushi chefs are honestly making restaurant quality sushi rolls! They’re also always so kind.

simply-asia-thurmont.editorial_summary: Chinese, Thai & Japanese fare, including sushi, is served in an open, red-walled dining room.
simply-asia-thurmont.review_snippet: Just passing through and wanted to some got Chinese food. Lots of great options. Friendly staff and quick service

dominos-pizza-thurmont.review_snippet: We’ve had amazing experiences with Domino’s ever since they opened, and tonight was no exception. Our delivery driver, Demetri, was fantastic, friendly, quick, and professional. They continue to impress every time. Highly recommend!

the-sauced-savage-bbq-thurmont.review_snippet: Jason knows BBQ! His smoked pulled chicken is awesome, and his brisket is even more amazing! If you see his truck, stop and load up on some great eats, or ask him to cater your next event!

los-amigos-mexican-restaurant-thurmont.review_snippet: This was our first time here and we loved it. The food and service were great. The chicken was seasoned well. We would definitely recommend this place.

pupuseria-diana-marixa-thurmont.review_snippet: My new favorite place to have some homemade pupusas and most popular salvadorean Lunches in the neighborhood!!! 100% recommend it!!!

snowfox-grab-n-go-sushi-thurmont.review_snippet: If you love sushi and are looking for a new place to try, I highly recommend giving this place a try. I ordered a few party platters for a bday celebration and they were gone within minutes. All the sushi was fresh and tasted amazing.

rockys-pizza-thurmont.editorial_summary: Bright, simple restaurant offering casual Italian bites, plus a diverse menu of pastas & entrees.
rockys-pizza-thurmont.review_snippet: My hubby and I stopped here on a whim on our way home from sunny FL and we had a hankering for pizza. This really hit the spot!! Very very good!! We practically polished the whole pie, taking one slice home.

mountainview-convenience-ev-charging-bee.review_snippet: Friendly and a convenient place to park a semi without many options in the area. Outstandingly clean.

sara-keps-kitchen-thurmont.review_snippet: I can say, without a doubt, that Sara put together the best Charcuterie boards I have ever had, ANYWHERE! She went above and beyond to make my wife’s 40th birthday surprise that much better! Thank you again

middletown-valley-pizzeria-middletown.review_snippet: Pleasantly surprised! We haven’t been in since the new owners took over (we haven’t been in probably 8 years); and it’s great. Pizza is solid; but the Fried Ravioli was so good. Glad to have a good local pizza spot!

jimmy-johns-middletown.review_snippet: First time trying Jimmy John's, I liked it.. Great sandwiches, clean place, friendly staff.

alekos-middletown.review_snippet: Aleko's dining experience was superb! I highly recommend the Meat Sampler and then share a slice of the Bakleva cheesecake. Thanks, Aleko's staff! Great job!

schroyers-tavern-at-maryland-national-go.review_snippet: The food is fantastic at Schroyer's Tavern, chef Matt puts a great deal of variety into the menu and everything is excellent. It's also a wonderful wedding venue.

sweet-babes-creamery-2-walkersville.review_snippet: I love Debbie Emmy and Beckett this is the best icecream in the world

louies-famous-fried-chicken-walkersville.review_snippet: The service was great and the atmosphere is like a little pizza shop. I got the Cheese Steak and Fries. Both were delicious and I will be ordering from here again when I'm in the area working.

taqueria-los-primos-walkersville.review_snippet: Very tasty beef soup, huge portion, fresh ingredients, and great price. I’ll definitely be back. Thank you! ❤️

indian-wok-walkersville.review_snippet: We ordered carry out meals. The food was hot, fresh, and delicious! We got the Manchurian cauliflower, chicken chili mango, and the Chana masala. Everything was flavorful. We will definitely be back to try more menu items!

kings-ny-style-pizza-walkersville.editorial_summary: Classic pies, subs & basic pasta dinners offered in a simple eatery with booth seating.

ott-house-emmitsburg.editorial_summary: Long-running, laid-back bar offering a sizable beer selection, pub fare & frequent entertainment.
ott-house-emmitsburg.review_snippet: Delicious food and great prices. The French onion soup was amazing.

carriage-house-inn-restaurant-catering-e.editorial_summary: Classic American fare & seafood in a landmark 1857 building with stone fireplace & period furniture.

tuscanys-pizzeria-emmitsburg.review_snippet: Excellent authentic New York style pizza. Super friendly staff, the food came quick, and it didn’t break the bank. We stopped here on our way back to DC after skiing and are very glad we did. Oh and easy parking.

ripleighs-creamery-emmitsburg.review_snippet: Great ice cream! They had several traditional and many unique flavors to choose from. The milkshake options were holiday themed, and there were many fun concoctions. Definitely worth a visit

palms-emmitsburg.review_snippet: As soon as we walked in we were welcomed with a smile. The food was amazing and the service was great! We do not live in the area, but we will make the trip just to eat here again. Thank you for your hospitality!!

rubes-crab-shack-llc-emmitsburg.editorial_summary: Vibrant, no-frills locale offering classic local seafood with all-you--can-eat crab specials.
rubes-crab-shack-llc-emmitsburg.review_snippet: Went here on Friday and it was a nice hole in the wall place. The food was fantastic and service was good! Only issues I had was the bathrooms didnt seem properly maintained but they were busy so I will give them the benefit of the doubt.

cafe-au-bouchon-emmitsburg.review_snippet: Lovely fine dining experience! Food and service exceeded expectations. Everything was fresh, delicious and presentation was top notch!

the-derby-restaurant-bar-new-market.review_snippet: We come here for lunch once a month and we have never had a bad experience. The servers are friendly and helpful. The food is always delicious and the atmosphere is nice.

pour-decisions-restaurant-bar-music-new-.review_snippet: Great wings for real! And cheap drinks! Kaitlin served up quick drinks all night! She was great! I went on karaoke night, sang my heart out! Tie one on at Pour Decisions!

kings-pasquale-new-market.review_snippet: I have been ordering subs from here for years and they are good, their pizza hits the spot but holy cannoli the limoncello cake 🤯 I tried it for the first time and it was amazing.

lighthouse-seafood-new-market.editorial_summary: Unfussy shop for fresh & frozen seafood, including shucked oysters, plus steaks & prepared eats.

morgans-american-grill-new-market.review_snippet: We popped in late with a large party and the staff was very accommodating. Great food & service. They had a special menu in addition to their regular and good sized dessert menus. I hate that I forget her name but thank you "Server 303"!

verilife-dispensary-new-market.review_snippet: Hayden is an absolute angel. Not only was I greeted with such a warm and friendly welcome but, they really helped me out today with my order. Definitely will be back! Thanks Hayden, you’re the best 💕

whistle-stop-restaurant-and-saloon-new-m.review_snippet: Legit💯 Good well seasoned BBQ, I live in Texas and the meat taste great without BBQ which is very rare to find. Shawn provided great service, overall my experience here was very pleasant. I would return and I would recommend! Thanks 😎

walkers-on-main-mount-airy.review_snippet: Stopped in to see what the cheesesteak hype was all about. For me it was just okay but my son got the patty melt said it was the best sandwich he ever had. Took over 25 minutes for our two sandwiches and they weren't even busy.

carterque-bbq-grilling-co-mount-airy.editorial_summary: Down-home standby with a patio serving wood-smoked BBQ dishes & sides, plus housemade sauces.

lu-joes-restaurant-lounge-mount-airy.review_snippet: Great time here. Green curry and pad Thai both came in large portions were delicious. Shock top was served cold and garnished with an orange. Nice surprise stumbling onto this American /Thai spot.

new-york-j-p-pizza-mount-airy.editorial_summary: Local pizzeria chain serving pies, pasta, subs & salads in a relaxed atmosphere.

jb-seafood-myersville.review_snippet: Cute little place! Friendly service. Shrimp in the shrimp taco special were huge! Only three would fit into each taco shell. The flour tortilla shells were a little tough, but we would definitely come again to try some of their crab fare!

nenas-curbside-cafe-myersville.review_snippet: Nena was so easy to work with, very thoughtful and most of all, the food was so delicious! Chicken Piccata was to die for ! You won’t be disappointed.

martins-farm-market-myersville.review_snippet: We wanted to try their subs. I got roast beef, wife got ham and cheese. So fresh, great taste, fresh meat and cheese, and sub rolls are really good. We both agreed, best subs we ever had!! The ladies are always so nice.

burger-king-myersville.editorial_summary: Well-known fast-food chain serving grilled burgers, fries & shakes.
burger-king-myersville.review_snippet: We were on a road trip and stopped here for lunch, we've never seen a Burger King quite like this one. The inside had a cool retro 50's vibe and everything was very clean. Hopefully this one doesn't get remodeled to a gray box 🤞

bonnies-at-the-red-byrd-myersville.review_snippet: Great Maw and Paw place to have a great home cooked meal...Loved the atmosphere and service was great 👍🏾... Carrot 🥕 cake was bomb.com

little-red-barn-ice-cream-cafe-burkittsv.review_snippet: Some of the best sandwiches and ice cream, around!!! The entire staff are some of the friendliest folks you'll ever meet! Homely and peaceful atmosphere, with that good 'ole country hospitality, just like being at Grandma's.

jojos-restaurant-tap-house-frederick.editorial_summary: Casual, brick-lined setting for globally inspired American eats & lots of craft beer.

showroom-frederick.editorial_summary: Modern-American cuisine by celebrity chef Bryan Voltaggio served in a chic former car dealership.

firebirds-wood-fired-grill-frederick.editorial_summary: Chain restaurant serving steaks, seafood & cocktails in an upscale lodgelike setting.

wags-restaurant-frederick.editorial_summary: Small, subterranean hangout known for burgers & American basics, plus happy hour at a long wood bar.
wags-restaurant-frederick.review_snippet: Lovely bar. Got the wag burger with wag fries. Was delicious 100% would recommend. Happy hour drink deals are insane. $1.38 vodka sodas. I have never seen anything like it in my life. Prices are great too!

sabor-de-cuba-restaurant-frederick.editorial_summary: Classic Cuban fare, including seafood & sandwiches, in a down-to-earth dining room with a bar.
sabor-de-cuba-restaurant-frederick.review_snippet: The food here was so good. The service was fast and friendly. Highly recommend!!! We will return!!

papa-johns-pizza-brunswick.editorial_summary: Pizza take-out & delivery chain offering classic & specialty pizzas, plus wings, sides & desserts.
papa-johns-pizza-brunswick.review_snippet: Joseph provided awesome customer service when previous door dashers miss-handled an order and he replaced the order so fast my delivery time wasn’t even affected. The DoorDash customer was very appreciative as well

kfc-thurmont.editorial_summary: Restaurant chain known for its buckets of fried chicken, plus combo meals & sides.
kfc-thurmont.review_snippet: I stopped here for a quick bite to eat. This combo Taco Bell/KFC is small but clean and fast service with a smile. My food was served very quickly and was hot and fresh. I reccomend this place for a quick bite to eat.

la-carreta-tacos-y-tortas-middletown.review_snippet: First time here, and I just had the absolute best shrimp tacos ever! Big shrimp, lots of flavor and two special sauces, plus the yummy chips!

subway-middletown.editorial_summary: Casual counter-serve chain for build-your-own sandwiches & salads, with health-conscious options.

ricci-italian-restaurant-walkersville.review_snippet: Food was good, staff friendly and attentive. Atmosphere was nice. Downside, we had reservations and had to be seated at a smaller table because the party prior wouldn’t leave. Other than that, would be back.

pizza-hut-walkersville.review_snippet: Ordered the Tuesday personal pizza deal online. My 2 pizzas were ready on time and were delicious! Only had to wait a minute or two when I went in to pick up my order despite there only being a couple people working.

monocacy-crossing-restaurant-frederick.editorial_summary: Imaginative American dishes & cocktails in a snug, country-style setting with a quaint patio.

so-thai-restaurant-new-market.review_snippet: Wonderful Thai food here in Urbana!! Great service; good portions; delicious dishes!! SO happy to welcome this terrific new restaurant!!!

habanero-mexican-food-bar-grill-new-mark.review_snippet: New in Urbana. Had Chicken and pork tacos. Very good. Wife had beef and shrimp tacos. Loved them. Staff very nice. Will come again...

averys-maryland-grille-frederick.editorial_summary: Unpretentious eatery offering steak & local seafood, with a focus on Maryland-style steamed crabs.
averys-maryland-grille-frederick.review_snippet: Took my mom out to eat again, decided to try out this restaurant. We loved it! If we're ever in a seafood craze we will be back!

burkittsville-ruritan-club-burkittsville.review_snippet: Good food ,beautiful outdoor atmosphere. Indoor .we injoy the ride over from hagerstown. People are very friendly and helpful. Wish i lived there.

callahans-seafood-bar-grill-frederick.editorial_summary: Longtime bar & grill offering seafood, steaks & modern American fare, with darts & beers on tap.

brookside-inn-burkittsville.review_snippet: Very cool if your into fun little dive bars and great bar food. Loved the fried mozz with garlic parm and marinara. The burgers were tasty and huge.

mays-seafood-restaurant-frederick.editorial_summary: Casual neighborhood veteran highlighting regional seafood specialties in a homey environment.
mays-seafood-restaurant-frederick.review_snippet: Love down home happy eating place. All kinds of seafood. Pricey. Steamed blue crab was dry but I am accustomed to juicy spicy boiled Louisiana crabs shrimp and crawfish. The crab soup was great.

santa-rosa-restaurant-frederick.editorial_summary: Homestyle Mexican & Salvadoran specialties & drinks are presented in a laid-back atmosphere.
santa-rosa-restaurant-frederick.review_snippet: The food is great. Service was good. The pupusa's were delicious, my grilled steak burrito was fantastic. My wife loved her food. Even the beans were awesome!

sandbox-brewhouse-frederick.review_snippet: Nice place and dog friendly. Their beers were good. You can order in food. Which was convenient. Loved their flights

prospect-point-brewing-frederick.review_snippet: We had our first visit here, and really enjoyed our time! There is seating outside with a great view, dog friendly, and great service. There was a food truck outside, and a $5 draft deal on the current Thursday.

rockwell-brewery-frederick-2.review_snippet: Great beer, live music on weekends, staff is friendly, food trucks plus they have some light food of their own that's not bad.

mcclintocks-back-bar-frederick.review_snippet: Spacious bathrooms. Offers 2 private single room bathrooms. Very rare occassion to see a whiskey barrell in a bathroom. Easily accessible off of far end of mainroom

dragon-distillery-frederick.review_snippet: A great place to have a couple of cocktails. Smaug's Fire is one of the best drinks I may have ever had. We ordered two sets of Nacho's. Chicken on one, pulled pork on the other. Both were winners. Service was how it should be.

milkhouse-brewery-new-market.editorial_summary: Charming farmhouse-turned-taproom offering handcrafted microbrews with local art & foods.
milkhouse-brewery-new-market.review_snippet: This is a beautiful brewery with great beer and a relaxed family friendly atmosphere. The surrounding countryside is georgious!

roasthouse-pub-frederick.editorial_summary: Relaxed, cozy tavern featuring 20 rotating taps of craft brews & elevated pub grub.
roasthouse-pub-frederick.review_snippet: Such a great restaurant. The food was fresh and delicious with fantastic flavors. The service was friendly and fast! Music choices were amazing and just added to our great experience! Thank you for the great dinner!

stone-silo-brewery-mount-airy.review_snippet: Been here a few times now and it has been consistently excellent. Very friendly staff. Nice variety of beers and usually has a food truck on site for food. Lots of outdoor seating and areas to lay your blanket down and relax on grass.

springfield-manor-winery-distillery-brew.editorial_summary: Warm rooms in a refined inn on a winery estate with casual dining & complimentary alcohol tastings.

catoctin-breeze-vineyard-thurmont-2.review_snippet: Good Chardonnay. Beautiful property. Good service. We were lucky there was an amazing Argentinian barbecue the day we visited.

brewery-fire-emmitsburg.review_snippet: Excellent little brewery hidden away next to the bowling alley. I had several beers, including a rare Kentucky Common, all were excellent. It is a nice cozy little place, and the staff was very friendly and helpful.

upper-stem-brewery-myersville.review_snippet: What an AWESOME place to grab some local brew with family & friends. The beer and service was TOP SHELF! You have to check them out when in Hagerstown even if you’re just passing through.

heritage-spirits-middletown.review_snippet: Great selection and great staff, always helpful

willow-oaks-craft-cider-and-wine-burkitt.review_snippet: Friendly staff, excellent cider! Their taproom has groups views of the mountains. You can also get organic meat and plants from the farmer who owns it. There is also local art. Come all year round for a peaceful afternoon.

orchid-cellar-meadery-and-winery-middlet.review_snippet: My fiancee and I sampled a set of four mead flights each with a cheese platter, while relaxing and enjoying the tranquil scenery. It was a lovely experience, and the views are beautiful. We will be back!

a1-beer-wine-walkersville.review_snippet: James and Sam are the best. I always look forward to see them. They are very welcoming and sweet ppl... very funny too

walkersville-wine-spirits-walkersville.review_snippet: Anyone you get is very nice! Quick in an out service with a wide selection!

db-liquors-walkersville-md-21793-walkers.review_snippet: Great place with a great selection. It's not the biggest store but it fits everything that you'll need for a weekend night in.

d-b-beer-wine-walkersville.review_snippet: I've been all around Frederick, and this is my favorite spot to stop when I want something to drink. Its very well organized, easy to navigate, and the owners care for their community. I love to see earnest small business owners doing well.

rosie-cheeks-distillery-woodsboro.review_snippet: Great tasting room...and many options to choose from. Highly recommended!

emmitsburg-liquors-emmitsburg.review_snippet: Excellent selection of beer , wine and liquor. There’s rare to find bourbons. Friendly service and well stocked clean store. What else do you need!!

rj-beer-wine-and-convenience-emmitsburg.review_snippet: Top notch Customer Service, the team that works here it friendly and hospital. Why drive the extra mile ❤️

pauls-pit-stop-liqour-emmitsburg.review_snippet: Paul's is a great little quick stop Liquor store with decent prices, afew snack options but check the expiration dates. Great selection of whiskey for this downhome coutryfied store.

mountain-liquors-emmitsburg.review_snippet: Easy in and out. Large selection of everything. Great prices!

liquidity-aleworks-mount-airy.review_snippet: Excellent award-winning craft brewery nestled in an old bank building in downtown Mount Airy. Great food (Walker's on Main) available on site

red-shedman-farm-brewery-and-hop-yard-mo.review_snippet: Dope brewery with plenty of ipas to choose from. Food is mostly chips, beef jerky, crackers and hot dogs. Service is really quick and they have plenty of seating indoors

freys-farm-mount-airy.review_snippet: Nice out of the way brewery with some great beers. We were there on a Saturday night and we were the only ones there. It would be a great place to have a party or gathering with a bunch of friends.

new-market-liquors-new-market.review_snippet: Mr. D is a wonderful person, always in a good mood when serving customers. I keep coming back because of him!

six-wicket-vineyards-myersville-2.review_snippet: Absolutely gorgeous vineyard. The owners are so lovely and knowledgeable and went above and beyond to accommodate our private event. The wine is the best in the DMV and the cricket is a blast! Can’t wait to go back.

woodsboro-liquors-woodsboro.review_snippet: Nice local store very fair prices and selection. Friendly staff.

pj-gilligan-dry-goods-mercantile-co-burk.review_snippet: Beautiful step back in time. Friendly conversation about the items for sale and local history. I bought a gift for my son who's returning to college soon.

puerto-rico-distillery-brunswick.review_snippet: What a fun time in a Puerto Rican inspired atmosphere! I loved pretty much every flavor of pitorro - I recommend trying a flight to sample a handful first.

fordham-lee-distillery-middletown.review_snippet: Cory did an excellent job! I even bought a bottle of the orange dreamsicle ❤️

pathfinder-farm-distillery-tasting-room-.review_snippet: I purchased a bottle of the bloody butcher bourbon online to share with some Bourbon loving coworkers and they were all taken back by this bourbon. The service and delivery was great. It is top notch in our book!

country-spirits-inc-thurmont.review_snippet: I go to this store multiple times a week and 95% of the time they have everything I need in stock. The staff are always friendly, and if they can they help carry my order to the car.

new-market-plains-vineyards-new-market-2.review_snippet: Great whites...didn't taste one I didn't like. Reds are forthcoming but the Rose and red offering were exceptional. Warm and inviting, you feel like you are royalty.

hidden-hills-farm-and-vineyard-new-marke.review_snippet: The wine was delicious. My husband and I each had a flight (white and red) all had amazing flavor. Great atmosphere and beautiful horses Live music and super fun

pathfinder-farm-distillery-burkittsville.review_snippet: What an excellent local find. Audrey was brilliant explaining to us about the local moonshine. Also terrific with local knowledge! Recommend the blueberry cocktail 🍸

miscellaneous-distillery-mount-airy.review_snippet: We stopped by on a Bachelor party and we got a tour and had a tasting. We left with a bunch of products. They were very informative and helpful, not to mention the great products, the rum was our favorite! Highly recommend

crown-rose-estate-weddings-and-distiller.review_snippet: I have visited this venue for several events. The estate is beautiful and the grounds are well kept. Anyone looking for a wedding or corporate event spot would do well to consider Crown Rose Estate.

distillery-lane-ciderworks-burkittsville.review_snippet: This is a fun place to taste traditional hard ciders, buy historic apple varieties that no one else has anywhere, and chat with random fellow visitors. Friendly staff.

black-ankle-vineyards-mount-airy-2.review_snippet: We absolutely love visiting this vineyard! Very cozy venue with outstanding wine. The staff is phenomenal as well! We always feel welcomed and appreciated.

links-bridge-vineyards-woodsboro.review_snippet: What a beautiful place. Our dog and kid were so welcomed, the wines were great, and walking down to the creek to meet Lucy (the winery dog) and talking to local highlighted the visit.

big-cork-vineyards-burkittsville.review_snippet: Great find! Arrived early, but was greeted warmly by manager. Wine servers were very friendly and knowledgeable. The grounds are impeccable. Really glad we found this place!

mazzaroth-vineyard-middletown-2.review_snippet: Gary was a fantastic host! The experience was intimate and personable! We had a group of 10 and we all enjoyed the tasting and tour experience! Beautiful place!

frederick-wine-house-frederick.review_snippet: Amazing selection and really good prices on a lot of options. The staff are super friendly, helpful, and have a lot of experience in the local wine scene! They really know their stuff.

red-heifer-winery-thurmont.review_snippet: The staff and owners were wonderful. We had had a tough day and they went out of their way to be so hospitable. The wines and food were delicious.

loew-vineyards-mount-airy-2.review_snippet: Small winery mostly dry wines. Staff was very nice parking was fine. Seating inside very limited but plenty of picnic tables outside.

walkers-overlook-walkersville.review_snippet: A truly stunning wedding venue that we love working at! Beautiful in every season with endless photo opportunities around the property. Such a gorgeous place to get married in Maryland!

olde-towne-tavern-frederick.editorial_summary: Crab cakes, beer & live bands offered in a neighborhood joint with Ping-Pong, darts & pool.
olde-towne-tavern-frederick.review_snippet: All around great bar for all ages. Feels like a college bar, but it’s more of a neighborhood institution. Good beer, good food, great service.

spacie-gracie-frederick.review_snippet: Fantastic ambiance, cocktails, and service! And five star people watching spot in the front window seats

river-bar-grill-frederick.review_snippet: Took my friend here today for his birthday. Got a Bloody Mary and steak/shrimp quesadilla, he got calamari. Everything was delicious along with their homemade chips and salsa. Staff was very friendly, great ambience. Definitely recommend.

belles-sports-bar-grill-frederick.editorial_summary: Time-tested tavern offering pizza & other American eats, plus happy-hour deals, pool, darts & TVs.
belles-sports-bar-grill-frederick.review_snippet: Great pool tables and the food is really good! Friendly staff and cold beer. Everything on the menu has been outstanding. The chicken tenders can come in any of the wing flavors, hint hint. Try them!

the-banyan-frederick.review_snippet: Came for dinner, Kyra helped us out and was very kind. Food was good, overall great experience

maxwells-burgers-shakes-frederick.review_snippet: Came here for a quick anniversary dinner and loved it! Service, friendliness, selection, food quality, and even Kristen (?) The cashier did something extra for us celebrating that just made the night even better. Will be back!

anchor-bar-frederick-frederick.review_snippet: This place never disappoints! 10/10 would recommend to all my friends and family. The wings are some of the best I’ve ever had! If you’re looking for a good sports bar in Frederick, then look no further!

upstairs-smoketown-brunswick.review_snippet: Great venue for al music. Pictures are from the Amish Outlaws show.

valley-grill-sports-bar-middletown.review_snippet: What an awesome sports bar!! The smoked wings were absolutely 🔥🔥! Went on a Sunday to catch some NFL games, which were on every TV. Great drink specials too!

the-bull-pen-walkersville.review_snippet: Great food! Fun atmosphere for all ages. Plenty of parking. Menu has something for everyone. Everything is VERY clean. Friendly staff. I will definitely be back.

mount-airy-bowling-lanes-mount-airy.review_snippet: Shout out JEFF!! Hospitality, Friendliness, Good looking, All around Good people. Small town vibes & sweethearts everywhere. I'll be coming back every week.

smokers-paradise-mount-airy-mount-airy.review_snippet: Good products, good service and good prices👍👍👍

the-yellow-house-myersville.review_snippet: Nice local dive that has good bar food and cold drinks. Nice to have this place local.

the-lodge-myersville.editorial_summary: Veteran gay nightspot featuring drag shows & theme party nights in an energetic ambiance.
the-lodge-myersville.review_snippet: Great local bar to catch a drag show. Drinks were inexpensive and the DJ was excellent.

ostertag-vistas-myersville.review_snippet: Donna Easterday was absolutely wonderful to work with! On our wedding day she was able to make our ceremony go very smooth after a few changes. Also, the venue was just stunning and needed little to no decor.

cactus-flats-walkersville.review_snippet: Excellent home cooked food with generous portions, ice cold beers, and delicious home style fries. We would definitely stop in again! Great service as well. It's an all-around win.

myersville-market-crown-gas-station-myer.review_snippet: Amazing place!! I always get my gas here and it has the most friendly people ever! Highly recommend

wolfes-den-thurmont.review_snippet: Nice hometown bar with good food and beer. Would definitely come back.

merediths-good-luck-tavern-frederick.review_snippet: Hidden gem….Food and service were outstanding! Our server Bubbles was awesome! The food is fresh and a 10/10! Definitely will be back.

orioles-nest-331-frederick.review_snippet: Friendly private bar and restaurant but everyone welcome. Darts, pool tables. The crab soup could have more crab, kind of watery. Ample parking.

monkey-lala-frederick.review_snippet: Service is always great. Love this place for a great dive bar with amazing food if you don’t want to dine at Avery’s. Drinks are very reasonably priced and food is same as Avery’s. Always like to get some apps. Here is the crab pretzel.

gwenies-pastries-frederick.review_snippet: Best hot coca I have ever had with homemade toasted marshmallow. Hubby had a mocha. Will definitely be back.

deliciosa-bakery-inc-frederick.review_snippet: Muy Deliciosa! The pastries are wonderful, not sugary but flavorful. The cakes looked beautiful, I would definitely consider getting one from there for a special occasion next time.

treats-and-more-by-noy-frederick.review_snippet: Noy is the BEST! Give her all your dollars for yummy treats and soul-satisfying food. You will not regret it, not one bit.

uncle-ralphs-bakery-frederick.review_snippet: Oh heck yeah! I stopped in and got the little chocolate cookies and the little ginger ones. Wow! It’s a counter inside with some cookies you can buy there. Worth it!!

lowcarb-avenue-frederick.review_snippet: We bought sourdough bread. It tastes amazing with minimal ingredients. They bake fresh everyday.

cakebox-by-preeti-brunswick.review_snippet: Despite the short two-day notice, they delivered an exceptional birthday cake for my wife. The cake was ready on time for pickup and the quality, presentation, and taste were outstanding. Truly exceeded my expectations!

corner-store-brunswick.review_snippet: A little shop in Brunswick fully stocked with Sint-Bernardus, Leffe, Chimay, Goose Island and even Duvel. Always helpfull and friendly. Me and Jessie will surely be back sometime in the future to shop here again.

baskin-robbins-brunswick.editorial_summary: Ice cream parlor chain known for its many ice cream flavors & sundaes, plus cakes, drinks & other treats.

catoctin-mountain-orchard-thurmont.review_snippet: Beautiful Farmer's Market with local foods and jams. Excellent food, I've been coming here since I was in middle school and can say this place never disappoints.

rachels-cakery-walkersville.review_snippet: I ordered cake pops for my son’s birthday and they were delicious! The kids and parents loved them and they looked fantastic! I’ll definitely be ordering again soon.

brick-block-cakes-walkersville.review_snippet: We’ve ordered a few times from Stephanie/Brick Block Cakes. She’s very personable and willing to work with custom orders! The mini donuts were awesome! The perfect quick snack for when you’re craving something sweet!

safeway-walkersville.editorial_summary: Longtime supermarket chain carrying brand-name & house-label groceries, plus a deli, bakery & more.
safeway-walkersville.review_snippet: Always a great store to go to for good quality products

walkers-village-shopping-center-walkersv.review_snippet: Nice little shopping center with a Safeway. There's also the obligatory liquor store, A CVS, the Village Tavern Restaurant/Bar, a Chinese Restaurant, Mexican restaurant and a Vetinary Clinic.

el-chapito-latin-market-walkersville.review_snippet: This is a small town business. I support them as often as I can. Prices are a little higher then Safeway on some items but you can get a 3 ltr.bottle of Pepsi here.

sweethaus-treats-walkersville.review_snippet: My first time there today. Such a cute little hidden gem!! Mark was so friendly and knowledgeable. He is a definite asset to the company.

bakery-de-france-frederick.review_snippet: During construction so a little chaotic, flour delivery is around the side of the building. DO NOT MAKE IMMEDIATE RIGHT TOWARDS DOCK! Wait for the traffic control light to turn green and follow road around to the dock

jubilee-foods-emmitsburg.review_snippet: This is the best store. Everyone is helpful and nice. The vegetables are the best. In addition to the meat and seafood they have to the best. I recommend the shrimp and the ribeye steak and corn on the cob.

frederick-health-emmitsburg-emmitsburg.review_snippet: Best urgent care I been to in a long time. Dr Laura Parker is awesome no wait n got my autistic son taken care of.

token-cookies-frederick.review_snippet: I had the pleasure of buying a TOKEN Cookie & it was exceptional! Warm, soft & chocolaty goodness. Reminded me of my Abuela’s recipe I’ll continue to buy can’t wait for the next batch!

lil-cakes-creamery-new-market.review_snippet: Fresh and tasty, interesting flavors. Friendly and nice staff. And price is really good for two scoops of ice cream compared DC.

the-buzz-new-market.editorial_summary: Quaint spot in a strip mall with locally sourced breakfast & lunch bites, plus coffee & baked goods.

mommy-magic-cakes-mount-airy.review_snippet: We ordered a special cake for our mom's 85th Birthday. It was the most beautiful cake and so delicious!! It was larger than expected. Carrot cake with cream cheese frosting. Thanks Cate!!

bold-love-farm-and-bakery-mount-airy.review_snippet: Very friendly and professional staff. Highly recommend!

moms-essentials-and-baking-mount-airy.review_snippet: It's a homemade bread store make delicious products

jessicas-snowballs-mount-airy.review_snippet: The girls working during Oktoberfest were so kind to our kids. We will definitely be back! Delicious snowballs!

myersville-farmers-market-year-round-mye.review_snippet: Great variety of vendors. Got nice fresh produce today. Have bought jewelry, soap, and baked goods in the past.

casimir-bakery-myersville.review_snippet: The cookies were perfect for my son's birthday party and they were delicious!

146-provisions-myersville.review_snippet: Beautiful store, lovely owners and so many unique/delicious/high quality options! I purchased salami, ghee, green tea and a mushroom plush. Will be back with my daughter to pick out some sweet treats next time!

united-states-postal-service-woodsboro.review_snippet: Andy helped made the passport application very nice and easy :)

highs-woodsboro.editorial_summary: Roadside convenience store providing fuel, drinks & takeaway fare, including sandwiches & hot items.
highs-woodsboro.review_snippet: My daughter worked near here and raved about the chicken salad sandwich. OMG got 2 for our lunch and went back for 2 more. Best I have ever had. beats chick filet or fancy deli. would drive here any time for that sandwich

daisy-cakes-bakery-jefferson-md-burkitts.review_snippet: Cute local bakery. $6 for a dozen of 2nd day donuts is definitely worth it. They have cute thanksgiving cookies. Highly recommended.

frederick-fudge-ice-cream-co-frederick.editorial_summary: Whimsical, old-fashioned ice cream shop with many frozen treats, fudge, lemonade & a small patio.
frederick-fudge-ice-cream-co-frederick.review_snippet: One of my favorite ice cream shops downtown! They serve Hershey's ice cream alongside the fudge. Lots of flavor options, and plenty of outdoor seating.

brusters-real-ice-cream-frederick.editorial_summary: Counter-serve chain where all of the ice cream selections are made fresh on-site every day.
brusters-real-ice-cream-frederick.review_snippet: I love that Bruster’s has a dairy free ice cream option! I got their chocolate raspberry truffle oat milk ice cream and really enjoyed it! This is their small size waffle cone - still a huge helping!

beef-n-buns-n-paradise-frederick.editorial_summary: Quick comfort-food spot for burgers, dogs, wraps & 40 shake flavors in casual, tropics-themed digs.

sweet-babes-creamery-new-market.review_snippet: Best ice cream around! Great quality and value. Very friendly staff. Perfect for the community!

rocky-point-creamery-brunswick.editorial_summary: Colorful, spacious shop selling ice cream cones with creative ingredients, plus pints to-go.

cold-stone-creamery-frederick.editorial_summary: Ice cream chain offering design-your-own creations hand-mixed on a granite slab, plus shakes & more.
cold-stone-creamery-frederick.review_snippet: Had a great experience at this location! They offer great service, pet friendly outdoor seating, and a clean bathroom!

ritas-italian-ice-frozen-custard-frederi.editorial_summary: Italian ices & frozen custards star at this counter-serve chain with a range of other cold treats.
ritas-italian-ice-frozen-custard-frederi.review_snippet: This place is just the best. Nothing like the custard and flavored ice combinations to cool you down on a hot summer day. They don't open till 3pm on Saturday, and you can expect to wait in line for a while (10-20 minutes).

zoes-chocolate-co-frederick-md-frederick.review_snippet: The chocolate baklava is amazing! Never had anything like it. I took some home to my Lebanese friends and they looooved it! The owners clearly know how to make baklava and chocolate!

sweetfrog-frederick.editorial_summary: National chain with dozens of flavor combinations of soft-serve frozen yogurt, plus sorbet.
sweetfrog-frederick.review_snippet: Really cool place. You make your own tasty treat. I went overboard on it and its deliscious. Weighted almost a pound.😀

misty-meadows-farm-creamery-thurmont.review_snippet: We’ve been here several times and this is the first time I tried the ice cream sandwich. 2 homemade chocolate chip cookies with vanilla ice cream and sprinkles. DELICIOUS! 11/10 would recommend.

ice-house-thurmont.review_snippet: Get my water here every few days. I would give 5 stars but it took my money a couple of times when it's out of change to give back.

debbies-soft-serve-myersville.review_snippet: This place has amazing milkshakes. The butterscotch flavor was really good, would highly recommend this place. You can order from outside through the walk up window so you can stay safe at the same time.

mountaindale-convenience-store-thurmont.review_snippet: Very nice gas station and convenience store. Good selection of food, snacks, beer, and liquor. Clean restrooms.

potomac-street-creamery-myersville.review_snippet: Small town ice cream shop that I love. Came here after going to Crystal Grotto Cavern. Small shop where everyone was super friendly. Moderately priced but so worth it. If in the area again, would definitely stop by again.

highs-gas-station-thurmont.editorial_summary: Roadside convenience store providing fuel, drinks & takeaway fare, including sandwiches & hot items.
highs-gas-station-thurmont.review_snippet: Plenty of ice cream here! They had scooped ice cream cones, and in the back they had pints and bigger containers. We got a pack of candy fake cigarettes for the 18-year-old. Haha

happy-cow-creamery-woodsboro.review_snippet: Delicious milk. 🥛 Farm fresh eggs. Healthy cows. Friendly family-owned and operated. Great find! After our first visit to the farm to buy milk (about a month ago), we’ve returned three more times for milk, eggs, and even milkshakes.

dairy-queen-treat-frederick.editorial_summary: Soft-serve ice cream & signature shakes top the menu at this classic burger & fries fast-food chain.
dairy-queen-treat-frederick.review_snippet: Very well run. Seems to be fairly busy most of the time but great employees move the line fast. Leading to the fast, friendly service. Highly recommend for a quick, yummy snack.

brown-cow-creamery-mount-airy.editorial_summary: Small-batch ice cream made from seasonal, local ingredients offered in this cozy farmer's market.

cows-cones-myersville.review_snippet: We have always enjoyed this place for ice cream but the new owners have made it even better! Great atmosphere with nice outdoor seating, lighting and games! The ice cream is always delicious, very reasonable prices, great service!

pocantico-jersey-farm-and-creamery-woods.review_snippet: The beautiful smell of a farm - I love it ! I really love to support local businesses. Nice place for a soft serve ice cream and to see livestock up close.

myron-martin-peace-hollow-farm-market-bu.review_snippet: The best place around in southern Maryland. Love everything that they have and great customer service! If you haven’t been there I suggest to put it on your must do list.

field-fresh-farmers-market-frederick.review_snippet: Great little farmers market, I made the trip down from Hagerstown to grab a few things and was very pleased. Grabbed an egg and cheese biscuit Sammie from The Fred and it was a great biscuit sandwich. I will be back just for that biscuit.

ems-garden-market-frederick.review_snippet: I randomly decided to stop by. Eddie and Maria were very hospitable and showed me around. We talked a bit on life and agriculture. The garden is beautiful and the produce fantastic. 10/10 recommend. I will make a trip back.

pleasant-hill-produce-walkersville.review_snippet: They’ve awesome Organic Veggies and fruits. Also, the milk is really nice. The taste of their fruits is amazing.

nicks-produce-frederick.review_snippet: Bruce is very nice. I bought tomatoes and a cantaloupe. Terrific! Great prices and service

urbana-library-farmers-market-new-market.review_snippet: Great local market with very nice vendors, live music and food truck.

middletown-farmers-market-middletown.review_snippet: Love to go! Nice to see all the booths! Mostly pick up dinner when Rollin' Smoke Meats & Sweets are there!

roseda-farm-market-at-hedgeapple-frederi.review_snippet: Very friendly and knowledgeable staff. Great selection of beef, pork, and various sausages. We got a cowboy steak for a celebration and it was perfect!

rolling-green-farm-market-new-market.review_snippet: Nice owners, clean, they have a great selection, and everything I've tried thus far has been great! I also find new things to try, and I can't wait to get home.

moms-organic-market-frederick.editorial_summary: Chain retailer of organic produce, raw foods, sustainable seafood, natural remedies & cosmetics.
moms-organic-market-frederick.review_snippet: Sending all the good vibes to Eric. Really made my day when he passed out some positive affirmation stickers. Love when service is extended past the "how's your day going." Thank you!

sycamore-spring-farm-frederick.review_snippet: The world needs more places like Sycamore Spring Farm. Farmer Carol’s farm products are second to none in quality. She truly cares for the land and her animals. Support a local farm before there aren’t any left.

h-mart-frederick-frederick.editorial_summary: Asian grocery store chain supplying imported packaged foods & housewares plus ready-to-serve meals.
h-mart-frederick-frederick.review_snippet: The variety in ethnic foods is umatched! They have an in-store food court with sushi, ramen, etc. They also have a fabulous bakery. If you need to find a unique ingredient, this is the place for you. Too much to post on a review!

thurmont-main-street-farmers-market-thur.review_snippet: This is a seasonal a Saturday morning outdoor market. Lots of different vendors and crafts.

hawkins-produce-new-market.review_snippet: Hawkins is such a cute mom and pop produce stand. The grape juice they make is incredible. They are also dog friendly. It's definitely worth the trip for a small town experience.

heritage-farm-park-walkersville.review_snippet: The parks are nice but I especially like the wrap around walking trail. The grounds are kept very clean and it's just a peaceful place to walk even when there are games are in session.

glade-link-farms-woodsboro.review_snippet: Very inexpensive place (thank you for that) beautiful strawberries. I Haven’t been blueberry picking but a coworker let me try his yield and they were plump & flavorful
